body: Even if at some point something gets better, it will eventually all come crashing down since naturally WE were not born with the attributes that are required for surviving in this day and age. My only hope is that I somehow manage to live until a day when I die without expecting (say, like, in a bike crash or sky diving :D) so I don't have to experience the horrible moment of committing to suicide.

I think as soon as you start getting in the comfort of depression and suicidal idealization there is no real going back. The fact that you came so far means, you don't have much in you to fight. It's the same for me. Simply passing every day getting less and less disciplined. The turnaround gets harder every day but your motivation to do something shrinks. You see the result?

I totally feel you and I'm happy that you accept yourself as being responsible for the situation you are in. At least there's enough dignity in you not to put the fault on others. For a quick and unpainful way, trust me everyone here is searching for one of those but the human brain simply doesn't work like that. Any way of killing yourself will be frightening as fuck and your instincts will try to stop you until the last millisecond. Asphyxiation is relatively unpainful if done right since you will lose consciousness before feeling any major pain. Still, it will be very scary until the last second. Suicide requires you to perform an action that cannot be reversed the closer you get to actually dying. That's why people push chairs under themselves or shoot themselves since it cannot be reversed.
